core_theory.funny_because: A teacher whose every sentence disables the one before it: the book opens by saying it cannot be written, then insists for 81 chapters. The comedy is structural self-sabotage — the aphorism that lands is the one admitting the limits of aphorisms. Slow delivery is mandatory: the paradox needs the room to catch up and fail.

doctrine.ontology: The way that can be told is not the enduring way.

The selector takes ONLY the stern/harsh aphorisms (39+9 tone-labelled), so the book hands him his own meanest lines.
